definitions.explanation: A sedimentary rock formed from compressed sand grains. Common in geology, architecture, and descriptions of natural landscapes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地層|ちそう}→地層：06366_chisou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{砂岩|さがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This geological layer is made of sandstone.

examples.japanese: {砂岩|さがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風化|ふうか}→風化：17583_fuuka⟧しやすい⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧だ。
examples.english: Sandstone is a type of rock that weathers easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{砂岩|さがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされて→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The red sandstone cliffs, lit by the setting sun, were beautiful.

notes:
Composed of {砂|さ} (sand) and {岩|がん} (rock). A basic geology term that appears in textbooks, museum exhibits, travel writing, and descriptions of natural landscapes. Sandstone is one of the most common sedimentary rocks and is found in many famous geological formations worldwide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂岩|さがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地層|ちそう}→地層：06366_chisou⟧: sandstone layer/stratum
- {赤色|せきしょく}{砂岩|さがん}: red sandstone
- {砂岩|さがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧: sandstone cliff
- {砂岩|さがん}{造|づく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: sandstone building

RELATED ROCK TYPES:
- ⟦{石灰岩|せっかいがん}→石灰岩：23396_sekkaigan⟧: limestone
- {花崗岩|かこうがん}: granite
- ⟦{泥岩|でいがん}→泥岩：23730_deigan⟧: mudstone
- {頁岩|けつがん}: shale
- ⟦{堆積岩|たいせきがん}→堆積岩：23353_taisekigan⟧: sedimentary rock (the category {砂岩|さがん} belongs to)
